boot_loaders.name: systemd-boot
boot_loaders.notes: UEFI-only boot manager; select an existing firmware Boot#### entry.

boot_loaders.name: rEFInd
boot_loaders.notes: UEFI boot manager; select an existing firmware Boot#### entry.

boot_loaders.name: LILO
boot_loaders.notes: Legacy BIOS loader; target disk and partition must already contain a valid installation.

boot_loaders.name: SYSLINUX
boot_loaders.notes: Legacy BIOS bootloader family; not a UEFI boot manager.

boot_loaders.name: EXTLINUX
boot_loaders.notes: Legacy BIOS loader for supported filesystem layouts.

boot_loaders.name: PXELINUX
boot_loaders.notes: PXE network boot component; requires external DHCP/TFTP or compatible network boot infrastructure.

boot_loaders.name: MEMDISK
boot_loaders.notes: SYSLINUX helper for disk images; not an independent boot manager.

boot_loaders.name: Chainloading
boot_loaders.notes: A boot technique, not a separately installable loader; a concrete firmware target is required.

boot_loaders.name: U-Boot
boot_loaders.notes: Embedded-platform bootloader; not a PC UEFI/BIOS drop-in replacement.

boot_loaders.name: Barebox
boot_loaders.notes: Embedded-platform bootloader; requires a supported board boot chain.

boot_loaders.name: Coreboot + SeaBIOS
boot_loaders.notes: Firmware stack, not an OS-level bootloader choice; firmware flashing is excluded.

boot_loaders.name: TianoCore EDK II
boot_loaders.notes: UEFI firmware development platform, not an installed OS bootloader entry.

boot_loaders.name: Limine
boot_loaders.notes: Current DuckOS bootloader; remains the safe default and external chainload menu host.

boot_loaders.name: GRUB Legacy
boot_loaders.notes: Historical BIOS-only GRUB generation; do not confuse with current GRUB 2.

boot_loaders.name: BURG
boot_loaders.notes: Historical GRUB-derived project; retained for classification, not recommended for new installs.

boot_loaders.name: kexec
boot_loaders.notes: Kernel-to-kernel handoff mechanism; requires a running privileged OS and a separate kernel loader.

boot_loaders.name: Plop Boot Manager
boot_loaders.notes: Legacy boot manager; target must already exist and be readable by firmware.

boot_loaders.name: Smart Boot Manager
boot_loaders.notes: Historical BIOS boot manager; availability and compatibility are not guaranteed.

boot_loaders.name: XOSL
boot_loaders.notes: Historical graphical BIOS boot manager; not a modern UEFI alternative.

boot_loaders.name: BootIt NG
boot_loaders.notes: Legacy commercial boot and partition manager; verify licensing and target compatibility.
